source_headline: Body "Source: Azania news agency, Bujumbura, in French 26 Jul 99   Text of report by Burundian news agency Azania on 26th July   [No dateline, as received] The rebels are withdrawing in search of new hide-outs. Two soldiers were killed and one wounded in Murinda when a vehicle was ambushed.   In Gatabo, where a concentration of rebels was reported, one soldier and three civilians were wounded during pursuit operations. Three civilians were taken hostage by rebels on Saturday night [24th July]. In the commune of Nyanda four presumed rebels were taken in for questioning, a local authority said.
